prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-52507 for Eastgate Clinics
prose.body:
Hi there,

Hope you’re having a great week! Just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-52507 for 5,489.38 USDC. We wanted to make sure this didn’t slip through the cracks.

If you haven’t processed this payment yet, you can send the funds to our standard settlement wallet: 0xfbb0c7b5c18b69f28e3e6969f679f2ba2a71567e. This is the same address we’ve been using for previous transactions with Eastgate Clinics, so you can feel confident sending it there.

Once sent, please let us know the transaction ID or share a screenshot so we can match it on our end and mark the invoice as paid. If you’ve already sent this, please ignore this note, sometimes our automated reminders overlap with manual checks!

If you have any questions about the line items or need a copy of the original invoice again, just hit reply and we’ll get it to you right away. We really appreciate your continued partnership with Harrow Legal.

Best regards,
Billing Team
Harrow Legal
